subtitle: xAI Real-Time Intelligence, Social RAG & Multimodal Systems
scope_note: Constructive information-theoretic retrieval, multimodal auditing, and verification proposals; purely local simulation.

primary_strengths: Ultra-low-latency ingestion of live X social stream alongside web and multimodal feeds.
High responsiveness on breaking events, emerging developer chatter, and real-time trends.
Direct, conversational tone adaptable to technical debugging and rapid synthesis.
core_bottlenecks: Live RAG blends unverified viral rumors, satire, and primary advisories into one voice.
Coordinated bot-echo copy-pasta and stale high-like posts distort naive engagement ranking.
Charts/screenshots and technical claims lack automated pixel-level and sandbox verification.
system_profile.design_north_star: Separate primary timestamped evidence from social pulse via Dual-Cone Causal Chiasm, spectral bot de-echoing, and closed-loop verification.

improvements.title: Dual-Cone Primary-Source Splitter & Domain Time-Decay Index
improvements.current_gap: Real-time retrieval conflates viral jokes and rumors with primary engineering/CVE advisories, while older high-like posts outrank newer official corrections.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Maintain separate PrimaryEvidenceCone and SocialPulseCone indexes with domain-calibrated exponential freshness decay lambda_domain and SUPERSEDED_BY_T+delta tags; evaluate cones via causal_chiasm() and surface a ?? Split-View Caution Badge when EI < 0.25.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Uses causal_chiasm(primary_cone, social_cone) Effective Information (EI) and ?? glyph to flag uncorroborated viral divergence.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: SocialVsPrimaryGate ranker + TimeDecayIndex freshness scorer with explicit conflict badge.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: +35 ms dual-cone merge and -3% recall on evergreen posts. Mitigation: disable fast decay automatically for historical queries.
improvements.verification_method: Replay 50 breaking technical/CVE timelines; verify newer official corrections outrank stale viral posts within 15 min.

improvements.title: Pixel-Level Multimodal Chart & Frame Integrity Audit
improvements.current_gap: Social media charts and video screenshots frequently use truncated Y-axes, cropped timestamps, or edited captions that mislead pure-vision VLM summaries.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Run a pre-summary pixel/luminance histogram, axis-tick OCR consistency check, and metadata/aspect verification pass (PixelHistogramAudit) before synthesizing media claims.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Computes 256-bin luminance A_tau(p) and structural tick-interval checks analogous to fieldglass.overlay histogram diagnostics.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: PixelHistogramAudit preprocessing check emitting axis-truncation and crop warnings.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Stylized infographics confuse OCR tick parsers. Mitigation: mark unparsed axes as 'unverified scale' rather than guessing values.
improvements.verification_method: Test curated corpus of 80 deceptive/truncated charts vs. canonical plots; assert >= 85% warning recall.

improvements.title: Spectral Bot-Amplification & Echo-Cluster Deduplication
improvements.current_gap: Coordinated copy-pasta repost campaigns inflate raw engagement metrics, causing echoed talking points to dominate top-K retrieval.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Cluster candidate posts via minhash similarity and Renyi H2 author-graph collision entropy; collapse echo clusters into 1 canonical representative while reporting unique_cluster_count alongside raw_post_count.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Directly applies fieldglass.metrics.renyi_h2(author_cluster_dist) to quantify independent-source diversity.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: SpectralDeEcho clustering pass over top-200 retrieved social items.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: +18 ms clustering latency and accidental collapse of legitimate quote-tweets. Mitigation: preserve distinct commentary edges above 35% novel token threshold.
improvements.verification_method: Inject synthetic 50-account copy-pasta bursts into benchmark feeds; verify cluster count collapses to 1 while independent sources remain.

improvements.title: Closed-Loop Sandboxed Code & Numerical Verification Harness
improvements.current_gap: Fast technical responses sometimes emit plausible-looking physics, financial, or code snippets with off-by-one or unit errors.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Route quantitative and code claims through an ephemeral read-only verification sandbox (AST parse, unit/dimensional analysis, and property test execution) prior to final response emission.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Mirrors Fieldglass test-gated verification before publishing any telemetry claim.
improvements.concrete_deliverable: SandboxedVerifyLoop execution wrapper attaching pass/fail check badges to snippets.
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Increases tail latency on complex multi-file snippets. Mitigation: 500 ms fast sandbox budget with explicit 'unexecuted draft' tag on timeout.
improvements.verification_method: Run 120 quantitative physics/code prompts; verify >= 96% pass AST + unit assertions.

improvements.title: Separated ClaimLedger, Open-Audit Receipts & 2x4 Braille Timeline
improvements.current_gap: Witty conversational framing obscures which statements are verified facts, and users lack portable, zero-token offline audit bundles or tactile event timelines.
improvements.proposed_architecture: Emit a machine-readable ClaimLedger sidecar (executed=False, tokens_used accounting, primary_source_count, report_sha256) cleanly separated from persona prose, alongside a 72-column 2x4 Unicode Braille event-timeline digest.
improvements.fieldglass_grounding: Reuses fieldglass-causal-chiasm/v1 SHA-256 sealing and plate.save_braille_bundle().
improvements.risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Persona stripping could miss subtle irony. Mitigation: extract verifiable timestamped propositions directly from evidence cones.
improvements.verification_method: Validate ClaimLedger JSON schema, report_sha256 determinism, and Braille non-blank cells.

telemetry_profile.routing_policy: EI(Primary, Social) < 0.25 or cone conflict -> emit ?? Split-View Badge; code/math claim -> SandboxedVerifyLoop prior to emit
